description: Which excavation method the Electrical Safety Authority guideline allows near a located underground electrical distribution line: hand, vacuum (hydro) or machine. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. This covers electrical distribution lines only; gas, communication, water and sewer owners set their own requirements, and the instructions on your locate form govern.

area.description: Whether the excavation is inside or outside the located area on the locate form.

clearance.description: Planned clearance from the line to the dig. Unit: m or ft.

locate.description: Locate status: current (received, not expired, markings clear), none (not yet requested or received), expired (expired or markings unclear).

method.description: Method being considered: mech (mechanical), vac (vacuum excavation) or hand.

orientation.description: Whether the dig runs parallel to the line (parallel) or crosses it or works near a point on it (cross).

test_holes.description: Whether the line has been exposed by test holes with depth and alignment confirmed.

name: hydro_excavation_vs_mechanical_checker
title: Hydro Excavation or Mechanical Digging Near Buried Electrical Lines
